@patternfly/patternfly.note: The npm tarball ships no license file. Text below is the LICENSE.txt of the upstream repository (github.com/patternfly/patternfly) for the same release line, and matches the `license` field of the published package. This entry also covers PatternFly's own binary assets emitted into dist/assets: the pf-v6-pficon webfont and the PF-Bkg-Generic / Felt-Bkg-Generic background SVGs. The third-party faces PatternFly carries are listed separately below.

assets.name: Red Hat Display, Red Hat Text, Red Hat Mono (variable webfonts)
assets.origin: Bundled by @patternfly/patternfly and emitted verbatim as dist/assets/RedHat{Display,Text,Mono}VF*.woff2. Upstream: github.com/RedHatOfficial/RedHatFont
assets.note: Reserved Font Name "Red Hat": the fonts are redistributed unmodified and under their original names.

assets.name: Font Awesome Free (solid webfont)
assets.origin: Bundled by @patternfly/patternfly as the "Font Awesome 5 Free" @font-face and emitted verbatim as dist/assets/fa-solid-900-*.woff2. Upstream: fontawesome.com
assets.note: Only the font file is redistributed. Its terms are the SIL OFL 1.1, whose full text is reproduced in the Red Hat fonts entry above; the Reserved Font Name is "Font Awesome" and the file is unmodified.
